profile.owner: Jobber (legal entity Octopusapp Inc.), private, venture backed company headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Co-founder and CEO Sam Pillar; investors include General Atlantic, Summit Partners and OMERS Ventures.
profile.target_customers: Small home and commercial service businesses across 50+ trades (lawn, cleaning, HVAC, pest and others), from solo operators to teams of about 15 users. Claims 100,000+ businesses and 400,000+ service pros. Horizontal tool, not pest-specific.
profile.pricing: Published. Monthly list (no commitment): Core $49 (1 user); Connect $139 (1 user) to $399 (15 users); Grow $199 (1 user) to $499 (15 users); Plus $499 (5 users) to $699 (15 users). Annual billing lowers these (Core $29/mo, Connect from $99, Grow from $149, Plus from $399 at renewal rates), with promos up to 40% off through Oct 30, 2026. Extra users $29/mo. Add-ons: Marketing Suite $99/mo, AI Receptionist $29/mo, Pipeline $49/mo (bundled in Plus), Jobber Bookkeeping from $149/mo (US only), Jobber Central quoted by account manager. 14-day free trial. Status convention in this file: features limited to Plus or sold separately are marked Add-on; Connect or Grow gating is noted in the feature notes.
profile.deployment: Cloud SaaS (web app at jobber.com) plus native mobile apps; no desktop or on-premise version.
profile.mobile_app: Jobber: Field Service Software (iOS, Android and tablets; one app for owners, office and technicians; CarPlay and Android Auto support added Aug 2026).
integrations: QuickBooks Online (two-way legacy and new integration; no QuickBooks Desktop sync)
Gusto payroll (timesheets and reimbursable expenses, US)
Zapier and public GraphQL API with App Marketplace (100+ apps)
Thumbtack, Angi and Oply lead marketplaces
strengths: Very easy to learn and set up; G2 ease of use 9.0 and Capterra 4.6/5 from about 1,487 reviews, setup in hours rather than weeks.
Transparent published pricing with a free trial and low entry price, unlike most pest-specific vendors that quote custom prices.
Strong customer-facing workflow: branded quotes with optional add-ons, client hub, online booking, card and ACH payments, Tap to Pay, autopay.
Broad ecosystem and fast release cadence: QuickBooks Online, Xero, Zapier, public API, 100+ marketplace apps, frequent AI and marketing releases.
Well regarded support and free one-on-one coaching, frequently praised in reviews.
weaknesses: Pest compliance is thin: chemical tracking is web only (not in the mobile app), on select plans, with no labels, SDS, state reports or Wisconsin support.
No pest-specific commercial or specialty tooling found: no bait station or device barcodes, facility maps, termite graphs or WDI reports, and no native inventory.
Reporting is the most common review complaint (fragmented, limited custom reports unless on Plus); also some app sync bugs and limited customization.
Costs climb with per-user fees and paid add-ons (Marketing Suite, Pipeline, AI Receptionist, Bookkeeping); several reviewers call per-user pricing steep.
Billing gaps for recurring pest accounts: no bulk price increases on existing jobs, no automatic late fees, no built-in general ledger (only a managed bookkeeping add-on).
profile.wisconsin_notes: No Wisconsin-specific compliance support found (no mention of ATCP 29, landscape registry notice or posting signs); chemical tracking makes no state compliance claims. No Wisconsin pest control customers identified in Jobber marketing or reviews; pest testimonials (Advanced Pest Control, JP Pest Control Service, Pagel Services) give no locations.

features.notes: Pipeline board tracks requests and quotes by customizable stage with lost-deal reasons; $49/mo add-on or bundled in Plus. Requests and quotes alone are basic tracking.
Customizable lead sources per client, lead source report and revenue by lead source chart on the insights dashboard. Close rate by source not documented.
Branded quotes with templates, photos, deposits and optional upsell line items (Grow and up). AI can draft quotes from similar past work.
Clients approve quotes in client hub and sign by drawing or typing; signature can be required. DocuSign integration also available for formal agreements.
No door-to-door canvassing app, territory map or knock tracking found in Jobber materials.
No native commission rules found; Sequifi / SequiPay payroll integration (Connect and up, US) handles commissions from approved timesheets.
Automated quote and invoice follow-ups on Connect. Email campaigns (win-back, promotions, referrals) need Marketing Suite, $99/mo; no SMS marketing.
No cancellation reason codes or save workflows found for recurring jobs. Client re-engagement report lists clients with no closed job in 12 months.
Clients hold multiple properties, each with its own tax rate; staff confirm one invoice can bulk bill all of a client's properties, itemized per location.
Call tracking and recordings via CallRail integration; AI Receptionist ($29/mo) answers and records calls. No native click to call or caller ID pop found.
Recurring jobs repeat weekly, monthly or on custom schedules (for example quarterly) and generate visits and invoices automatically.
Seasonal programs modeled as recurring jobs with start and end dates or set duration; no dedicated rounds or season window construct.
Central Products and Services list plus optional add-on line items on quotes; no pricing tiers by property size or square footage found.
Jobber support confirms list price changes apply only to new line items, not existing jobs; feature requested, CSV re-upload is the only workaround.
Recurring job end date or duration sets the term; no auto-renewal, renewal reminders or early cancellation fees documented.
No termite or other warranty tracking with renewal billing found.
No dedicated re-service or callback tracking found; extra visits can be added to jobs but cost capture for callbacks is not documented.
Visits created automatically from recurring jobs on the chosen schedule; an unscheduled drawer holds visits without dates.
New schedule offers day, week and month views with drag and drop plus a map drawer pinning appointments by team member color.
Optimizes routes for one or many team members across one day to a week, with custom start and end points; plan tier not stated.
No assignment rules based on technician skills, certifications or licenses found.
Online booking and request forms on website, Google profile and client hub, included from Core. Customer self-rescheduling not documented.
Built-in GPS waypoints log location only at app actions (select plans). Live vehicle tracking requires FleetSharp devices.
Reschedule and reassign many appointments at once from the schedule or map, including shifting by a set number of days.
Jobber app on iOS, Android and tablets for schedules, job details, checklists, invoicing and payments.
Since March 2026, forms, visit details and time tracking work offline and sync later; payments and other actions offline not confirmed.
Chemical treatment records exist, but per the help center they are entered on the web only, not the mobile app. Custom forms are a workaround.
Custom job forms and checklists capture photos, notes and client signatures in the field; photo markup supported.
No barcode or QR scanning of devices or stations found in Jobber documentation.
Collect card, ACH, Tap to Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay from the app, with tipping and on-site invoicing.
Clock in and out, visit timers, timesheets and crew clock-in (Connect and up; automatic time tracking on Grow; breaks on Plus).
No native truck stock; PLY marketplace app tracks parts per technician, truck or job with low-stock alerts.
Chemical treatment records (chemical, concentration, applicator, weather, address) entered separately on web, select plans; no amount or area fields or state compliance claim.
Chemicals list with registration numbers and tank mixtures; no label or SDS document storage mentioned.
Stores company and applicator license numbers for chemical records; no license categories, expiry dates or alerts documented.
Application history sortable by date, client or applicator and downloadable as CSV; no reports formatted for state regulators.
Generic appointment reminders exist, but no pesticide-specific pre- or post-application notices found.
No restricted-use pesticide controls or RUP record fields found.
Jobber staff acknowledge no built-in inventory; users rely on PLY, SOS Inventory or QuickBooks integrations.
Jobber does not name Wisconsin or any state in its chemical tracking or pest control materials.
No bait station, trap or insect light trap inventory per site found.
No facility floor plan or device map feature found.
No per-device pest activity history or trend reporting found.
No AIB, SQF, BRC or food safety audit documentation found.
Client hub covers requests, quotes, visits and payments; access to service reports, maps, labels or SDS not documented.
No customer sighting logs or corrective action tracking found.
One invoice can cover multiple properties or jobs; customer PO numbers and net terms on invoices not confirmed.
No termite graphs, bait monitoring or WDI reports found; Jobber's own PestPac comparison credits only PestPac with termite workflows.
Generic multi-visit one-off jobs (Aug 2026) with material line items and job costing; nothing wildlife-specific.
Multi-visit jobs and job checklists could model bed bug work; no customer prep checklist feature documented.
Seasonal mosquito or tick programs only as generic recurring jobs with start and end dates; nothing mosquito-specific.
Jobber Payments processes cards, ACH bank transfers (US), Tap to Pay and digital wallets, with instant payouts.
Card on file charged automatically on the recurring job billing schedule; automatic payments on Connect and up.
Per visit or fixed price per period billing, with monthly, per visit, job close or custom invoice timing; annual prepay not explicitly documented.
Manual named tax rates and tax groups assigned per property; no address-based rate lookup or per service taxability documented.
Automated overdue invoice reminders by email or text; late fees must be added manually; no service holds or payment retries documented.
Consolidated invoice across a client's jobs or properties and a client balance summary report; account statements not documented.
No automatic proration or cancellation balance handling found for recurring jobs.
No self-serve general ledger. Jobber Bookkeeping, from $149/mo (US only), is a managed bookkeeper service producing financial statements.
QuickBooks Online sync of clients, invoices and payments on Connect and up; QuickBooks Desktop not supported beyond a client list import.
One-way Xero sync of clients, items, invoices and payments, built and maintained by Xero; no Sage or NetSuite found.
No deferred revenue handling for prepaid agreements found.
Job costing tracks labor, materials and expenses per job with profit (Grow and up); Plus adds supplier invoice matching and profit alerts.
Timesheets sync to Gusto (Connect and up, US) or Sequifi; production-based technician pay not documented.
Client hub lets customers request work, approve quotes, view past and upcoming visits, pay invoices and deposits, tip and refer.
Automatic confirmations, reminders and on-my-way texts (Connect and up), plus schedule change notices.
Two-way texting with customers, including images, on Grow and up.
Automated Google review requests with follow-ups and competitor comparison are part of Marketing Suite ($99/mo, included in Plus).
Completed checklists or job forms can be emailed on site; no automatic report listing chemicals applied, since chemical records are separate and web only.
20+ built-in reports: invoices and payments, client balance summary, taxation, projected income, visits, quotes, recurring jobs; insights dashboard.
Client re-engagement report lists lapsed clients only; no retention or cancellation rates by route, technician or service.
Team productivity report shows visits, job revenue, tracked time and revenue per hour by team member.
Custom reports and AI-built reports on Plus only; lower plans get column customization and CSV export.
Jobber Central add-on links separate accounts per unit for consolidated visibility; pricing via account manager.
Preset levels (field crew to manager, plus admin) and custom permissions per area such as pricing, job costing, reports.
Public GraphQL API via Developer Center, App Marketplace with 100+ apps, and Zapier.
Data Import Service (clients, products, jobs, up to 100 historical quotes or invoices from CSV or XLSX) offered only with Plus premium support.
AI quote drafting, campaign generator, website chat assistant, Claude and ChatGPT connectors; AI Receptionist ($29/mo) and AI custom reports (Plus) cost extra.
Website builder included on all plans, plus embeddable request and booking forms and multi-step request forms.
Marketing Suite ($99/mo) adds social posting and marketing plans; direct mail via PostcardMania and call tracking via CallRail integrations.

extra_features.notes: Answers calls and texts 24/7, books visits, creates requests, escalates by keyword, logs transcripts and recordings; $29/mo for 100 conversations.
Query and update clients, jobs, quotes, invoices and schedule from Claude or ChatGPT (Oct 2026).
Dedicated human bookkeeper, bank feed sync, monthly close within five days and tax packet; from $149/mo, US only.

extra_features.feature: Automated expense capture and supplier invoice matching
extra_features.notes: Snap receipts or forward supplier invoices; Jobber drafts expenses and matches them to jobs by PO number (Plus).
Set target margin for one-off jobs and get notified when profit falls below it (Plus).
Custom workflow automations listed as a Grow plan feature, beyond the standard reminder and follow-up automations.
Define tank mixtures from chemicals in the chemicals list for treatment records.

extra_features.feature: Progress invoicing, instant payouts and business financing
extra_features.notes: Payment schedules on quotes and invoices, instant access to funds, and pre-approved business financing offers.
Leads from Thumbtack, Angi and Oply flow directly into Jobber requests.
Compares your Google review performance against top local competitors (Marketing Suite).
Manage visits, directions and on-my-way texts from the vehicle display.
Audit who changed timesheets, requests, quotes and invoices; merge duplicate clients and properties with related records.
Phone, email and chat support plus free product coaching on all plans; dedicated onboarding on Plus.
